W01.drivers: Narrow, sloping shoulders over a trunk that is barrel-rounded front and back in profile. Long thin arms with the hands hanging low. Thin legs with knobby knees and a slight knock-kneed set. Long, flat feet. Not fat or muscular; the overall build differs from the ordinary bodies.
axial_cues: upper trunk rounded front and back in profile (barrel/egg shape)
slight forward curve of the upper back
limb_cues: long thin arms, hands reach about mid-thigh
knobby knees with a visible bulge

structure.axial_section_shape: deep, rounded, egg-shaped upper trunk over a narrow pelvis
structure.joint_integration: knees and elbows stand out as knobs against thin segments; shoulders sit low and slope
structure.segment_relations: long arms, slender legs, relatively short trunk-to-leg section, long feet
structure.load_path: weight sits slightly forward over the knees and runs down thin shanks onto broad flat feet

non_structural_factors.notes: A slight stoop adds to the read, but the trunk shape and the build of the joints drive it

W02.drivers: Typical slim adult male proportions with a straight profile

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary oval chest tapering to the pelvis
structure.load_path: straight vertical line through hips, knees and ankles

W03.drivers: Ordinary front view. In profile the trunk is somewhat deeper, with a rounded back and buttock, which reads as soft or heavier tissue rather than different anatomy.

structure.axial_section_shape: deeper oval trunk with a soft belly and buttock

W05.drivers: Nearly the same as W01: narrow sloping shoulders, a barrel-rounded trunk in profile, long thin arms, knobby knees and long feet
axial_cues: rounded, deep upper trunk in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: egg-shaped deep upper trunk over a narrow pelvis
structure.joint_integration: knobby knees and elbows on thin segments; low, sloping shoulders
structure.segment_relations: long arms, slender legs, long feet
structure.load_path: slightly forward over the knees onto broad feet

W06.drivers: Ordinary front view. The profile shows a fuller chest and buttock, still within the human range.
axial_cues: somewhat deep chest and buttock in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary trunk with a fuller chest and buttock

W07.drivers: Ordinary build with slightly broader shoulders

W09.drivers: Ordinary build with slightly wider hips and thighs

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary trunk with a slightly wider pelvis

W11.drivers: Massive, heavily sculpted muscle. A very wide, inverted-trapezoid trunk with a deep, forward-thrust chest and hunched back in profile. Thick bowed legs with bulging knees, very large wide feet, big hands, and a short pelvis-to-trunk relation. The profile is irregular, and a stray fragment floats near the hand.
axial_cues: very wide shoulder girdle and lat flare
deep chest thrust forward in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: huge wedge-shaped trunk, deep and forward-heavy
structure.joint_integration: large knotted joints; shoulders blend into a massive trapezius mass; bent knees
structure.segment_relations: short legs relative to the trunk mass, big hands and feet, wide stance
structure.load_path: weight carried forward and down through bent, bowed knees onto broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: Muscle and stance dominate, but the trunk shape and the size of the feet and hands go beyond a human bodybuilder

distinguishing_features: W01 and W05 are slight and thin-limbed. Their shoulders are narrow and slope, the trunk is a deep rounded egg in profile, the arms are long, the knees are knobby and the feet are long. W11 is the opposite: an enormously wide, muscle-wedged trunk, thick bowed bent-kneed legs, and very large hands and feet. Mass, shoulder width and limb thickness separate the two types with no labels needed.
